data.long_meaning: In Latin, Emalia is derived from the name Aemilius, which means rival or emulator. This name has been popular in the Christian world due to its biblical connection to the Roman noble family Aemilius. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emalia usually hope their child will grow to embody rival or emulator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
